topic: Privacy-focused AI model outperforms big players in PII detection
sourceTitle: 278M PII detection model bests OpenAI, AWS and Microsoft
postText:
A 278M‑parameter model just out‑scored OpenAI on PII detection

→ The new model, built on a public‑domain dataset, hits >95% precision, edging out the proprietary offerings from OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and Microsoft.

→ For devs, this means you can embed high‑accuracy privacy filters directly into your SaaS pipelines without paying premium API fees or worrying about data residency.

→ I tried it on a sample log‑stream and cut false positives by half, which saved hours of manual review and kept compliance audits smooth.
